_meta.purpose: Pre-Sprint-1 baseline. Diffed after every sprint to guard against regressions in Toolwiki LLM-prompt outputs. The 'mustContainSubstrings' arrays capture the Toolwiki-biased phrases that must STILL be produced when the resolved prompt is run with the Toolwiki project context — even after S4.4 ('LLM-Prompt-Tenant-Var-Swap') moves them from hardcoded strings into tenant-config-driven templates.
_meta.diffPolicy: Sprint 1-3: source-file SHA must match. Sprint 4+: source-file SHA may change (refactor) but Toolwiki-resolved prompts must still contain every substring in mustContainSubstrings (compare via integration test that runs builders with toolwiki project fixture).

mustContainSubstrings: You are writing the FULL DRAFT of an article for toolwiki.ai
Every article must be primarily about AI/ML tools, AI features, AI concepts
You are producing the OUTLINE for an article on toolwiki.ai
toolwiki.ai publishes ONLY content that is primarily about AI/ML
You are writing the FULL DRAFT of a COMPARISON article for toolwiki.ai
A comparison article evaluates 2-4 named AI tools head-to-head
ki-wissen` collection on toolwiki.ai — the trust layer of the site
You are an editor for toolwiki.ai. Create content for a comparison-grid-4 Instagram slide.
You are an Instagram hook specialist for the German AI tools niche.
Claude vs ChatGPT: which is better?
